Fix 4 blocker issues identified in review: (1) Test expectations incorrect for non-abbreviated format - tests expect 'Y', 'mo' suffixes when calling formatPatientAge(patient) without abbreviated=true, should expect 'years', 'months' instead (affects lines 530, 537-538, 547-548, 553-554, 562-563, 568-569, 574-575, 580-581 in formatPatientAge.spec.ts); (2) Test expectations incorrect for abbreviated format spacing - tests expect '2Y', '18Y' but implementation returns '2 Y', '18 Y' with space (lines 531, 563, 569, 575, 581); (3) PLAYWRIGHT_GUIDE.md formatting corrupted at lines 231-248 - multiple template strings concatenated on single lines; (4) Test description at line 462 doesn't match implementation - says '5 weeks 0 days' but implementation returns '5 weeks' only when remainingDays is 0.

Fixed all 4 blockers identified in Round 1 review: (1) corrected test expectations for non-abbreviated format to use full words like 'years' and 'months', (2) corrected abbreviated format test expectations to include spaces (e.g., '2 Y' not '2Y'), (3) fixed malformed template strings in PLAYWRIGHT_GUIDE.md by separating them onto individual lines, and (4) updated test description to match actual behavior ('5 weeks' not '5 weeks 0 days'). The implementation itself was already complete and correct - all acceptance criteria are met.

Fix BLOCKER-5: Add pluralization logic to getRelativeDateSuffix() function to handle singular forms when count is 1. The function currently always returns plural forms (e.g., '1 years', '1 months') which is grammatically incorrect. Update the function to accept a count parameter and return appropriate singular/plural suffixes.

Updated formatPatientAge and formatPatientAgeTooltip to use the new signature. Added unit tests to verify singular forms for edge cases (1 day, 1 week, 1 month, etc.).
